label: User Menu
description: The avatar button that lives in the top-right of an app: a person's picture (or their initials when there is no picture), their name and email, and a dropdown holding account items and a Sign Out. Click it to open, click anywhere else to close. Out of the box it renders a sample person and four sample items from Static Data nodes; connect Name/Email/Avatar and an Items array and they win over the samples. Publishes Item Clicked with Clicked Label and Clicked Item Id, and a Sign Out signal to wire at the Log Out node beside Auth Pages.
